english.title: Allow aircraft in flight to tow article / pick up or raise person / animal / article without certificate / authorisation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aircraft in flight, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which, by means external to the aircraft,

(C)_[towed an article other than a glider, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..)]_
(D)_[picked up or raised a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_
(E)_[picked up or raised an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..),]_
(F)_[picked up or raised an article, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..),]_

when

(G)_[there was no certificate of airworthiness issued or rendered valid for that aircraft under the law of the country in which the aircraft was registered]_
(H)_[there was no express provision included in the certificate of airworthiness issued or rendered valid for that aircraft under the law of the country in which the aircraft was registered, or the flight manual for the aircraft, that it may be used for that purpose]_
(I)_[the aircraft had not been authorised to do so by the CAA or an organisation approved by the CAA to provide such an authorisation]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 88(1) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
were the operator/pilot in command of an aircraft in flight which, by means external to the aircraft,
towed an article other than a glider or picked up or raised a person, animal or article,
when there was no certificate of airworthiness issued or rendered valid for that aircraft under the law of the country in which the aircraft was registered OR
there was no express provision included in the certificate of airworthiness issued or rendered valid for that aircraft under the law of the country in which the aircraft was registered, or the flight manual for the aircraft, that it may be used for that purpose OR
the aircraft had not been authorised to do so by the CAA or an organisation approved by the CAA to provide such an authorisation
